title: Double Drip Cherry Cola Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Double Drip Cherry Cola captures the unmistakable taste of a fizzy cola drink infused with a sweet burst of Cherry. The cola flavour delivers a tangy caramel base with subtle spice, while the Cherry adds a juicy red-fruit note that lifts the blend and gives it a nostalgic, soda-inspired twist. The result is a lively, flavourful vape with a clean, familiar and refreshing taste. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits, including pod systems, starter pens and compact refillable devices. It offers smooth vapour, excellent flavour definition and a more comfortable throat hit thanks to its nic salt formulation. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Double Drip Nic Salts are available in a wide range of bold and satisfying flavour profiles to suit everyday vaping. Double Drip are one of the most celebrated and influential e-liquid brands in the UK and the masterminds of some of the most iconic vape flavours ever made. Vibrant, authentic, and highly inventive flavours are a hallmark of all Double Drip vape juices, and this newest collection of truly timeless flavours in smooth, satisfying nic salts won’t disappoint.
